target_performance: Complete a four-turn Spanish hotel check-in information exchange using a fixed guest card
process_acceptance: baseline is requested before teaching or a model answer
feedback names what communicated and the first meaning-blocking error
help progresses from error type to cue to one worked fragment
the learner supplies the corrected attempt
the transfer task changes setting vocabulary and one ambiguity
the response refuses fluency mastery retention and reminder claims without evidence
language difficulty is controlled with observable limits instead of the word beginner alone
review timing is labelled as a heuristic until a delayed attempt records the actual interval
learner evidence labels stay separate from artifact maturity labels
claim_boundary: A future passing process run would not by itself prove learner acquisition retention transfer fluency model superiority or cross-platform reliability.
